data.title: CEA Drives Thailand’s IP Finance Ecosystem Towards Global Growth
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organization), or CEA, hosted “CREATIVITY AS CAPITAL: Driving the Next Growth Frontier”as an Official Affiliated Programme of the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings. The programme featured a forum titled “Building the Enabling Environment: Policy Platforms and Intensives for a Competitive Creative Sector ,” sharing perspectives for creating friendly ecosystem that facilitates Thailand’s creative industry. It has included other essential instruments such as financial system development, IP for asset, foreign investment promotion, paving a way for local content creators to connect with the global markets.

data.title: Zoo turns viral hippo feeding fail into visitor attraction
data.description: A Thai zoo has responded to a viral video showing a woman repeatedly trying and failing to feed a hippopotamus by introducing a hippo statue that allows visitors to practice their aim, turning an internet sensation into an interactive attraction.

data.title: Lampang school hit by second fire in three days
data.description: LAMPANG — About 40 students fled a classroom at Bunyawat Witthayalai School on Monday after an air conditioner caught fire, the second blaze at the school in three days. No injuries were reported.

data.title: Indonesia fires have burned nearly two million hectares: monitor
data.description: JAKARTA (INDONESIA) - Fires in Indonesia that have caused a regional haze crisis burned through over 1.9 million hectares between January and the end of September this year, a monitor analysing satellite imagery said on Monday.

data.title: North Korea warns 'grave situation' prevailing along border
data.description: SEOUL — The powerful sister of North Korea's leader said Monday that "a grave situation is prevailing" along the Southern border, according to state media, and Pyongyang was considering deploying "more tactical strike means" to the area.

data.title: Kaeng Krachan race route revised over environmental concerns
data.description: Organisers of the Kaeng Krachan trail race have agreed to revise the route following opposition from environmental groups and academics concerned about the impact on the national park's fragile ecosystem.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor receives 2026 SEC Certificate for promoting financial literacy
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , led by Nipa Vanichavat , Head of Corporate Sustainability, represented the company in receiving the certificate of recognition as an “Organisation Promoting Financial and Investment Literacy among Employees” under the 2026 Financial Well-being in Workplace Programme, organised by Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), in collaboration with the Thai Listed Companies Association.

data.title: BDMS to take majority stake in GNPT to advance Thai cancer therapies
data.description: BDMS plans to increase its holding in Genepeutic Bio to 55% through a THB170 million investment, backing locally developed CAR-T cancer therapy.

data.title: Thai, S. Korean police bust scam centres in Bangkok
data.description: Thai and South Korean police have arrested two Chinese nationals and eight South Koreans suspected of operating three call scam centres in Bangkok that allegedly defrauded South Korean victims of more than 100 million baht.

data.title: Australian lawmaker critically hurt in 'deliberate attack'
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian independent lawmaker Helen Haines was struck by a car and suffered "critical injuries" on Monday in what Prime Minister Anthony Albanese described as a deliberate attack.

data.title: Credit card fraud reports over iPhone Duo pre-orders jump to 130 cases in Hong Kong
data.description: Hong Kong police have received nearly 20 more reports of unauthorised credit card transactions for iPhone Duo pre-orders over the weekend, bringing the total amount involved to HK$5 million (21 million baht).

data.title: ‘Nene Royal’ trademark bid withdrawn after outcry
data.description: A woman who filed a trademark application for the name of teen rocker Nene Royal has withdrawn it, the Department of Intellectual Property (DIP) said on Monday, following public criticism over her right to register the artist’s name.

data.title: Beyond the watch: How Bangkok's evolving collectors are shaping global watch culture
data.description: There was a time when luxury watch collecting in Thailand was primarily defined by two metrics - brand recognition and resale value. data.title: Siam Piwat Showcases Thai Heritage at 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Meetings
data.description: Bangkok, 19 October 2026 – Siam Piwat Group, a leading developer of world-class destinations and landmark real estate projects in Thailand, successfully welcomed delegates and participants attending the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings, held from October 12–18, 2026. Through a series of thoughtfully curated activities and immersive experiences at Siam Paragon and ICONSIAM, Siam Piwat delivered memorable cultural journeys that were exceptionally well received by international guests. The successful execution of these programmes further reinforced the Group’s commitment to showcasing Thailand’s distinctive identity, rich cultural heritage and contemporary lifestyle to the global community.

data.title: PM orders nationwide review of illegal foreign land ownership by end of December
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered provincial governors to look into land plots suspected of being illegally owned by foreigners by the end of December, with a view to subsequently revoking the title deeds.

data.title: Police 'lost control' during French protests, says interior minister
data.description: PARIS — French police "lost control" during nationwide protests marred by violence over the weekend, the interior minister admitted Monday, with President Emmanuel Macron calling for a security review.

data.title: New dinosaur tracks find in Udon Thani
data.description: What are believed to be fossilised dinosaur footprints have been discovered in Ban Phue district of Udon Thani province, with preliminary observations suggesting they were left by a large carnivore.

data.description: Panellists in Bangkok urged larger, independently run funds, shared investment platforms and incentives designed for women and informal workers

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri floats Ryujin clash as Nadaka snaps bonus drought in style
data.description: Nadaka Yoshinari finally ended his wait for a ONE Championship bonus with a US$100,000 finish, as CEO Chatri Sityodtong raised the prospect of a tantalising future kickboxing clash with Ryujin Nasukawa.
